status: Reserved before any scored February/August model comparison
purpose: One additional fixed model-change guard against repeated 2025 validation selection
data_scope: Released 2025 training labels only. Aggregate data-quality inspection and prior complement-month training already included these months; they are not previously unseen records.
trigger: After the current candidate set has completed its predeclared Jan/Jul, Nov/Dec and Apr/Oct gates, freeze the proposed model architectures, feature lists, routing gates and weights before fitting or scoring this guard.
refit_requirement: Refit both the accepted comparator architecture and each proposed replacement architecture with February/August departure labels excluded from fitting AND early stopping. Existing full-2025 predictions cannot serve as an independent guard comparator.
comparison: Matched architecture comparisons on the exact finite held-out row IDs eligible for each proposed route, using only the previously selected weight. Every unchanged route remains outside that component comparison.
valid_aobt_comparator: Refit the accepted depth-10 traffic residual architecture used by v7 on complementary months. Do not use its existing fitted model or in-sample predictions.
missing_clock_comparator: Refit the accepted ordinary missing-clock CatBoost architecture on complementary months, for the invalid-AOBT no-NM non-Rome route.
coverage: Unique non-null IDs, exact comparator/candidate ID and label agreement, finite predictions, and unchanged predeclared routing masks are mandatory.
statistics: Report RMSE separately for February and August and the pooled paired UTC-day bootstrap gain interval (1000 resamples, seed 20261002).
pass_rule: Each scored replacement improves RMSE in both individual months and has pooled 95% paired UTC-day gain interval lower bound greater than zero.
failure_rule: Exclude a failed replacement from the proposed policy. Do not tune its weights, features or routing thresholds to these guard results.
after_guard: Record all outcomes, including failures. February/August then cease to be a reserved guard. May/September remain reserved for a later separately frozen check.
limitations: This verifies fixed component changes. It is not an unbiased estimate of the complete legacy ensemble or a guarantee of ranking-set performance.
leaderboard_use: Official scores and ranking-set labels never select features, architectures, weights, routes or this guard.
